metadata.name: GetDualAuthDetails
metadata.description: Use this API to get Dual Authentication setup details.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: ActivityPanel
request_fields.description: Decision flag to get Dual Authentication details on the below mentioned activity. 1 = Card to Card Transfer 2 = Card to Bank Transfer 3 = Bank to Card Transfer 4 = Lost / Stolen 5 = Edit my Info 6 = Login 7 = Dual Authentication 8 = To register dual authentication details on card level Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Condition: At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: ProductID
request_fields.description: ID of the Account's Product Valid Values:0-9 Example: 1739,1758 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition: At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: AuthParameter1
children.description: 1st Dual authentication parameter. Valid Values: 1 = DateOfBirth 2 = Last4DigitsSSN 3 = CVVCVC2 4 = CurrentPIN 5 = ProfilePassword 6 = AuthenticationCode Example: 1

children.name: AuthParameter2
children.description: 2nd Dual authentication parameter. Valid Values: 1 = DateOfBirth 2 = Last4DigitsSSN 3 = CVVCVC2 4 = CurrentPIN 5 = ProfilePassword 6 = AuthenticationCode Example: 2

children.name: AuthParameter3
children.description: 3rd Dual authentication parameter. Valid Values: 1 = DateOfBirth 2 = Last4DigitsSSN 3 = CVVCVC2 4 = CurrentPIN 5 = ProfilePassword 6 = AuthenticationCode Example: 3

children.name: DualAuthenticationOnCard
children.description: whether dual authentication is required or not. Valid values : Yes , No

children.name: DualRegistrationRequired
children.description: whether registration of parameters is required. Valid values : Yes and No

children.name: NotificationTypeRequired
children.description: Displays whether notification source value is present on database or not. Valid values: 1 = Mobile(Indicate mobile number is not updated in database.) 2 = Email(Indicate Email ID is not updated in database.) 3 = Both(Indicate both mobile and email id is not updated in database) Condition: This tag will only reflect when 'ActivitiyPanel' value would be '8' and Email, Mobile or Both are not available in system.

children.name: NotificationType
children.description: Source to receive the authentication Valid values : 1 = SMS 2 = Email address 3 = Both

children.name: AuthCodeLockoutDuration
children.description: The time after which user will be automatically unlocked.

children.name: DualAuthCodeDefinition
children.description: Flag for Dual Authentication Code definition. Valid values : 1 = System Defined 2 = User Defined

children.name: Email
children.description: E Mail Address of Cardholder Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 @ . Example: ansh @gmail.com

children.name: MobileNumber
children.description: Cardholder's Mobile Phone Number Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 9876543210
